courseTitle: Alexander the Great in Three Days
courseSummary: Follow Alexander from the Macedonian court to the edge of India. By the end you can explain how he built his empire, why it split apart, and what it left behind.

lessons.title: Macedon before Alexander
objectives: Describe how Philip II strengthened Macedon
Explain the role of the Macedonian phalanx

lessons.title: Crossing into Asia
objectives: Identify the goals of the invasion of Persia
Summarize the Battle of the Granicus
subtopics: The conquest of the Persian Empire

lessons.title: Issus and Gaugamela
objectives: Compare the battles of Issus and Gaugamela
subtopics: The conquest of the Persian Empire

lessons.title: To the Hydaspes and back
objectives: Trace the route east into Central Asia and India
Explain why the army refused to go further
subtopics: Campaigns in Central Asia and India

lessons.title: Death in Babylon and the successor kingdoms
objectives: Describe the circumstances of Alexander's death

lessons.title: Course review and final quiz
objectives: Recall the main stages of Alexander's campaigns
Connect his conquests to the Hellenistic world
subtopics: The conquest of the Persian Empire
Campaigns in Central Asia and India
